title: Kernel-mode code loading is restricted
description: Kernel-mode drivers on Exchange servers MUST be restricted to approved, properly signed code. Limit SeLoadDriverPrivilege to authorized administrators, enable the Microsoft vulnerable driver blocklist where supported, and ensure test-signing and no-integrity-check boot options are disabled.
subject: Server

references.name: ISM September 2026 - ISM-2127 and ISM-2128, kernel-mode driver restrictions

remediation.description: Apply the relevant Windows security baseline and Group Policy to restrict driver-loading privileges, enable driver block protections, and prevent test-signed or integrity-check-bypassed boot configurations.
remediation.scriptTemplate:
# Review local policy assignments for SeLoadDriverPrivilege.
# Confirm the vulnerable-driver blocklist is enabled where supported.
Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\CI\Config' -Name VulnerableDriverBlocklistEnable -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

# Confirm test-signing and no-integrity-checks are not enabled.
bcdedit.exe /enum '{current}' | Select-String -Pattern 'testsigning|nointegritychecks'

# Review the effective user-rights assignment for Load and unload device drivers.

considerations: Restricting driver installation can affect approved monitoring, backup, antivirus, and storage software. Validate required drivers and vendor support before enforcement. The vulnerable-driver blocklist is platform- and policy-dependent; confirm its effective state rather than relying only on a registry value.
